    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    ApiKeyAuthenticationFilter
    Servlet filter that authenticates requests carrying a valid API key header.
    ApiKeyCredential
    Credential representing an API key, stored as a SHA-256 hash.
    ApiKeyCredentialRepository
    Repository for persisting and retrieving ApiKeyCredential records.
    ApiKeyService
    Service for creating and managing API key credentials.
    Credential
    Marker interface for credential types.
    CredentialAlreadyLinkedException
    Thrown when the credential being enrolled is already linked to an identity.
    CredentialIdentityRepository
    Repository interface for managing the mapping between credential UUIDs and identity UUIDs.
    CredentialRemover
    Deletes one credential module's credential rows.
    EmailAddressTakenException
    Thrown when an email address is already registered.
    EmailCredential
    Credential representing an email address linked to an identity.
    EmailCredentialRepository
    Storage for EmailCredentials.
    EmailCredentialService
    Registers and revokes email credentials.
    EmailLinkAuthenticationProvider
    Authenticates an email-link token: consumes it, then resolves its email credential to an active identity.
    EmailLinkGenerationSuccessHandler
    Answers POST /ott/generate with 202 at once and hands the real work to EmailLinkIssuer on another thread, so the response time does not reveal whether the address is known.
    EmailLinkIssuer
    Does the real work behind POST /ott/generate, off the request thread: looks up the address, stores the token's hash (the upsert that is also the resend limit), and sends the link.
    EmailLinkLoginMethod
    Email-link sign-in through Spring Security's oneTimeTokenLogin(), at its default URLs (POST /ott/generate, POST /login/ott), with who's hooks and no default pages.
    EmailLinkOutcome
    What EmailLinkIssuer.issue(String, String) did with a request.
    EmailLinkSender
    Delivers a sign-in link to an email address.
    EmailLinkSettings
    Settings for email sign-in links.
    EmailLinkTokenRepository
    Storage for sign-in link tokens.
    EnrollmentIdentityInactiveException
    Thrown when an enrollment is attempted for an identity that is not ACTIVE.
    EnrollmentToken
    An immutable enrollment token that links a Credential to a pre-existing Identity.
    EnrollmentTokenExpiredException
    Thrown when an enrollment token has passed its expiration time.
    EnrollmentTokenNotFoundException
    Thrown when an enrollment token cannot be found.
    EnrollmentTokenNotPendingException
    Thrown when an enrollment token cannot be redeemed because it is not in PENDING status (e.g. already redeemed or revoked).
    EnrollmentTokenRepository
    Repository for persisting and retrieving EnrollmentToken instances.
    EnrollmentTokenStatus
    Lifecycle status of an EnrollmentToken.
    Identifiers
    Utility methods for generating identifiers.
    Identity
    Stable internal identity record.
    IdentityRepository
    Repository interface for Identity persistence.
    IdentityRoleRepository
    Repository for managing the assignment of roles to identities.
    IdentityStatus
    Lifecycle status of an Identity.
    JdbcApiKeyCredentialRepository
    JDBC implementation of ApiKeyCredentialRepository backed by the who_api_key_credential table.
    JdbcCredentialIdentityRepository
    JDBC implementation of CredentialIdentityRepository backed by the who_credential_identity table.
    JdbcEmailCredentialRepository
    JDBC implementation of EmailCredentialRepository on who_email_credential.
    JdbcEmailLinkTokenRepository
    JDBC implementation of EmailLinkTokenRepository on who_email_link_token.
    JdbcEnrollmentTokenRepository
    JDBC implementation of EnrollmentTokenRepository backed by the who_enrollment_token table.
    JdbcIdentityRepository
    JDBC implementation of IdentityRepository backed by the who_identity table.
    JdbcIdentityRoleRepository
    JDBC implementation of IdentityRoleRepository backed by the who_identity_role table.
    JdbcJwtCredentialRepository
    JDBC implementation of JwtCredentialRepository backed by the who_jwt_credential table.
    JdbcRolePermissionRepository
    JDBC implementation of RolePermissionRepository backed by the who_role_permission table.
    JdbcRoleRepository
    JDBC implementation of RoleRepository backed by the who_role table.
    JdbcWhoPasskeyCredentialRepository
    JDBC implementation of Spring Security's UserCredentialRepository on who_passkey_credential.
    JdbcWhoPasskeyUserRepository
    JDBC implementation of Spring Security's PublicKeyCredentialUserEntityRepository on who_passkey_user.
    JsonAuthenticationHandlers
    JSON answers for sign-in endpoints that do not redirect.
    JsonGenerateOneTimeTokenRequestResolver
    Reads {"email": "..."} from the body of POST /ott/generate.
    JsonOneTimeTokenAuthenticationConverter
    Reads {"token": "..."} from the body of POST /login/ott.
    JwtCredential
    Credential representing a JWT identified by its issuer and subject claims.
    JwtCredentialRepository
    Repository for persisting and retrieving JwtCredential records.
    MailEmailLinkSender
    Sends sign-in links as plain-text email through a JavaMailSender.
    MailPasskeyAddedNotifier
    Emails the owner when a passkey is added, if the owner has an address. who-passkey does not depend on who-email-link, so the address comes from a lookup function, which autoconfiguration backs with EmailCredentialService.findOldestFor.
    MessageDigests
    Utility methods for computing message digests.
    PasskeyAddedNotifier
    Told after a passkey is registered, so the owner can notice a passkey they did not add.
    PasskeyCredential
    A passkey, as a who credential.
    PasskeyLoginMethod
    Passkey sign-in and registration through Spring Security's webAuthn(), at its default URLs, with who's collaborators where Spring hard-wires its own.
    PasskeyNameResolver
    Picks the name the passkey picker shows for an identity (the user entity's name and display_name).
    PasskeyRegistrationGuardFilter
    The answers Spring's passkey registration has no hook for.
    PasskeyRuntimeHints
    Native-image reflection for passkeys: Spring Security WebAuthn's JSON model and webauthn4j's CBOR model.
    PasskeyService
    Lists and revokes an identity's passkeys.
    PasskeySettings
    The relying party's settings, from who.passkey.*.
    PasskeySummary
    A passkey as shown to its owner.
    PasswordlessConfigurer
    Makes a browser chain safe for session sign-in, using only Spring Security's own types: Spring's SPA CSRF setup (CsrfConfigurer.spa()), 401 instead of login redirects, a logout that answers 204, no saved requests, a no-referrer policy, and who's session-backed WhoSessionSecurityContextRepository.
    PasswordlessLoginMethod
    A way to sign in to a browser session, contributed as a bean by a credential module (email links, passkeys, ...).
    PermissionsResolver
    Strategy for resolving permission strings for a given Identity.
    RbacPermissionsResolver
    A PermissionsResolver that resolves permissions by looking up the roles assigned to an identity and returning the union of all permissions granted to those roles.
    RbacService
    Management service for administering roles, permissions, and identity-role assignments.
    RequiresPermission
    Meta-annotation that expresses a @PreAuthorize hasAuthority(...) check as a named permission string.
    Role
    An immutable domain record representing a named role that can be assigned to identities and granted permissions.
    RoleAlreadyExistsException
    Thrown when a role is created with a name that is already taken.
    RoleNotFoundException
    Thrown when a role lookup by name finds no matching role.
    RolePermissionRepository
    Repository for managing the association between roles and permission strings.
    RoleRepository
    Repository for managing Role persistence.
    Secrets
    Generates secret tokens.
    WhoApiKeySecurity
    Adds the API key filter to a Spring Security chain.
    WhoApiKeySecurity.ApiKeyConfigurer
    Configurer that places the API key filter in an HttpSecurity chain.
    WhoAuthenticationToken
    Spring Security authentication token backed by a resolved WhoPrincipal.
    WhoAutoConfiguration
    Spring Boot autoconfiguration that wires all Who modules together.
    WhoDataSourceScriptDatabaseInitializer
    Initializes Who module database schemas by running each module's bundled DDL script against the configured DataSource.
    WhoEnrollmentService
    Service for managing enrollment tokens that link credentials to identities.
    WhoException
    Base class for all Who framework exceptions.
    WhoJwtAuthenticationConverter
    Converts a Spring Security Jwt (already validated by the OAuth2 resource server) into a WhoAuthenticationToken by resolving the JWT's issuer/subject pair to a WhoPrincipal.
    WhoMeController
    who's one endpoint of its own: GET /who/me tells a browser app who is signed in.
    WhoMeController.WhoMeResponse
    The signed-in identity.
    WhoMockMvcBrowser
    A MockMvc client that behaves like a single-page app in a browser against a chain built with WhoWebSecurity.passwordless().
    WhoOneTimeTokenService
    Spring Security OneTimeTokenService for email links.
    WhoPasskeyAuthenticationProvider
    Signs in with a passkey: verifies the assertion through the relying party, maps the verified credential to who's credential id, and resolves it to an active identity.
    WhoPrincipal
    Resolved principal placed into the security context.
    WhoProperties
    Configuration properties for the Who identity framework.
    WhoProperties.ApiKey
    Properties for the who-apikey module.
    WhoProperties.EmailLink
    Properties for the who-email-link module.
    WhoProperties.Enrollment
    Properties for the who-enrollment module.
    WhoProperties.MethodSecurity
    Properties for method security.
    WhoProperties.Passkey
    Properties for the who-passkey module.
    WhoRelyingPartyOperations
    who's relying party: Spring's Webauthn4JRelyingPartyOperations, configured from PasskeySettings, with three changes.
    WhoService
    Core service that resolves a Credential to a WhoPrincipal.
    WhoSession
    What a browser session remembers about a signed-in identity: ids only.
    WhoSessionRuntimeHints
    Native-image serialization for WhoSession.
    WhoSessionSecurityContextRepository
    Keeps only a WhoSession (ids) in the HTTP session and re-resolves the principal from WhoService on every request, so a suspended identity, a removed role or a revoked credential takes effect immediately.
    WhoTestSessions
    Signed-in HTTP sessions for tests.
    WhoWebSecurity
    Entry points for applying who to a Spring Security chain.
